text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing as it's my day off, I decide to head
out and do some shopping.
While at the
mall, I spot Tamamo Cross, standing still as
if in a trance.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: T-T-T-Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Right on time! For real, ya got a gift there! Seriously! I can't thank ya enough for comin' all this way!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
No, but your timin' couldn't be more
perfect! I'm in a real bind, ya see!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Look at all these fancy-schmancy stores!
How da heck am I s'posed to
know which
one to shop in?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
But look—I NEED a present for my parents'
wedding anniversary! So
please, Trainer,
ya gotta help me!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
My siblings are makin' our folks
okonomiyaki to celebrate, but I can't
help
since I'm here. That's why I thought I'd get
'em a present instead.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I don't got the cash for anything too crazy,
but... ya got any ideas?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The "fancy" stores she mentioned would
typically be considered
pretty easy on a
student's wallet. So if those are outside
the budget...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Many budget-friendly chocolate brands
look just as beautiful as the
high-end stuff,
and getting a box of chocolates still feels
like an
occasion.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I should have enough money for somethin' that looks fancy! Plus the kids would never say no to candy... Sounds like a plan!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that decision made, Tamamo Cross
and I make our way to the
sweets shops.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
N-no way... Please tell me they forgot to
put a decimal point in this
price
somewhere...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I could buy five big boxes of regular chocolates for the price of this one piece of chocolate!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Who in their right mind would spend their entire snack budget on one piece of chocolate... WHO?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I don't believe it... I don't! Do people eat
this pricey stuff on the
regular?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I explain that such luxurious treats are
usually saved for presents to
others, or for
when you really want to treat yourself.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Treat yourself?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I've heard of the concept, but... people
actually do it? Why? If you
have that much
extra cash, shouldn't ya save it? I don't get
it...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
But seriously, these prices... What's even a
good deal? Do deals even
exist here?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Good idea. I don't wanna jump into a
decision with this kinda money
on the line.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Phew... I feel like I can breathe again. Now, what should I get?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Since when are pancakes so pricey? I've
gotta buy a present for my
folks, so I can't
spend that much here.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I'll just have a glass of water! I'm not that
hungry anyway.

text_block_list.name: Cafe Staff
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, are you ready to order?

text_block_list.name: Cafe Staff
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. We'll have that out for you in a
moment.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hey! Why'd you order for me?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross and I have been working
hard on and off the track. So
I tell her that
I believe we deserve a reward, which is
why I'm treating
her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Of course, it's not just a reward. These
pancakes will also motivate us
to do our
best in our upcoming practices and races.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...I see what you're tryin' to do. You want
me to experience this whole
"treatin'
yaself" thing, right?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I still don't get what the fuss is 'bout, but...
well, guess it's too late to
say no. Let's see
what the hype's about!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... 'Sides, I'd have to be crazy to turn
down a free meal of bougie
pancakes!

text_block_list.name: Cafe Staff
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for waiting. Here's your
pancakes and juice. Enjoy your
meal!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
It's 'bout time! These things sure are fluffy.
Let's see...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: ...Mmph?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
(The richness that only eggs can provide is
filling my mouth! No, wait,
it's fadin' into
somethin' else...)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
(It's the whipped cream! It goes so well
with the saltiness of the
butter... And the
aftertaste is so light! I wanna eat
moooore!)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: DEEE-LISSSHHH!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Trainer, it's so good!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I definitely get wantin' to eat like this more often, even if it is tough on the wallet.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I guess there is somethin' to this whole
treatin' yaself thing.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Still... I wish my family was here to taste
these pancakes with me. The
squirts and
my parents deserve a treat too, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If her family is anything like Tamamo
Cross, surely they want to see
her thrive
out here, eating delicious food and
treating herself when
she works hard.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
They'd feel the same way 'bout me? Now
that ya mention it...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Brother
text_block_list.text:
Hey! How come Tama gets an extra
croquette and we don't?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross's Father
text_block_list.text:
Well, your sister took first place in the
race, didn't she? She deserves
a reward!
Tama, eat up and recharge for your next
race!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You're right... My folks were treatin' me all
the time...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Which makes sense... Of course they want
me to be happy. Geez...
why didn't I
realize it sooner?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Well... This feels like more than enough for
me, but I'll think about it.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, I better get back to these
pancakes! I'm not leavin' a single
crumb!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Newly free from the guilt of enjoying her
fluffy treat, Tamamo Cross
dives in with
renewed vigor.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Look, I want to finish these pancakes. I want to savor every bite! But I'm... I'm reachin' my limit... I needa slow down.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
No, it's just so rich—not just in flavor, but
in price... I know you're
treatin' me, but I
can feel the money flyin' away. I'm gettin'
chills...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sounds like she doesn't have much
tolerance for high-end
dining—even if
we're just at a cafe. Still, she makes sure to
finish
every last crumb of pancake.
